# Error #67: GovernanceDuplicateSigner

## Summary
- **Numeric Code**: `#67`
- **Variant Name**: `GovernanceDuplicateSigner`
- **Status**: Active (Enforced)
- **Client Toast Level**: `ERROR`

---

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::GovernanceDuplicateSigner` — the signer set lists the same address twice (one key in two slots).

---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Provide a signer set with each address at most once; duplicate entries are rejected even when the set is within `MAX_SIGNERS`.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/POLICY_GOVERNANCE.md#2-governance-failure-modes-and-mitigations`](../../docs/POLICY_GOVERNANCE.md#2-governance-failure-modes-and-mitigations)
